title: Choot ke ab na
body:
choot ke ab na phir akbar milenge
keh rahi hai sheh ki himmat toot ke
akbar phir akbar milenge choot ke..
<<DIVIDER>>
fikr kaahe ki hai ay akbar tumhe
qaid mil jayegi maa se choot ke
akbar phir akbar milenge choot ke..
<<DIVIDER>>
boli laila jaate ho akbar kahan
mere dil ki hasraton ko loot ke
akbar phir akbar milenge choot ke..
<<DIVIDER>>
jab shabab aaya to akbar mar gaye
reh gaya maa baap ka dil toot ke
akbar phir akbar milenge choot ke..
<<DIVIDER>>
so raha hai qabr par laila ka chand
kehte hai raaton ko taare toot ke
akbar phir akbar milenge choot ke..
<<DIVIDER>>
mar gaye saahil pa abbas e ali
keh diya shaah ke kamar ne toot ke
akbar phir akbar milenge choot ke..
<<DIVIDER>>
fauj waalon ghar ujad kar reh gaya
kya mila nanha sa jhoola loot ke
akbar phir akbar milenge choot ke..
<<DIVIDER>>
jald sunlo faqera ki aarzoo
dil taba hai toot ke maula choot ke
akbar phir akbar milenge choot ke..
author: Faqera
